title: Push-ups
description: Classic bodyweight press. Hands under shoulders, body in a straight line, lower the chest to the floor and press back up. Keep the core tight.

title: Bodyweight Squats
description: Feet shoulder-width apart, sit back and down as if into a chair, keep the chest up and knees tracking over the toes, then drive up through the heels.

title: Lunges
description: Step forward and lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees, then push back to standing. Alternate legs. Great for balance and leg strength.

title: Plank
description: Hold a straight line from head to heels on forearms and toes. Squeeze the glutes and abs. Start with 20 to 30 seconds and build up.

title: Glute Bridge
description: Lie on your back with knees bent, drive the hips up by squeezing the glutes, pause at the top, and lower slowly. Good for glutes and lower back support.

title: Dumbbell Rows
description: Hinge forward with a flat back and pull a dumbbell to your hip, squeezing the shoulder blade. Builds the back and biceps.

title: Deadlift
description: Hinge at the hips with a neutral spine and lift the bar by driving through the floor. A full-body strength lift; learn the form with light weight first.

title: Overhead Press
description: Press a barbell or dumbbells from shoulder height to overhead with the core braced. Builds shoulders and triceps.

title: Pull-ups
description: Hang from a bar and pull the chin over it, controlling the descent. Use a band or negatives if you cannot do a full rep yet.

title: Burpees
description: From standing, drop to a squat, jump the feet back to a plank, do a push-up, jump forward and leap up. Intense full-body conditioning.

title: Jumping Jacks
description: Jump the feet out while raising the arms overhead, then return. An easy warm-up and light cardio exercise.

title: Mountain Climbers
description: In a high plank, drive the knees alternately toward the chest at a fast pace. Raises the heart rate and works the core.

title: High Knees
description: Run in place lifting the knees to hip height with quick arm swings. A simple cardio and warm-up drill.

title: Brisk Walking
description: Walk at a pace that raises your breathing but still lets you talk. Low impact, excellent for fat loss and heart health, 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Interval Running
description: Alternate 1 minute fast running with 1 to 2 minutes easy jogging for 15 to 25 minutes. Improves endurance and burns calories efficiently.

title: Jump Rope
description: Skip with a rope using small hops on the balls of the feet. Trains coordination, stamina and calves. Start with 30-second rounds.

title: Bicycle Crunches
description: Lie on your back, bring opposite elbow to knee in a pedaling motion without pulling on the neck. Targets the abs and obliques.

title: Russian Twists
description: Sit leaning back with feet raised or on the floor, rotate the torso side to side, optionally holding a weight. Works the obliques.

title: Dead Bug
description: Lie on your back with arms up and knees at 90 degrees, extend the opposite arm and leg while keeping the lower back flat. A safe core stabilizer.

title: Cat-Cow Stretch
description: On hands and knees, alternate arching and rounding the spine with the breath. Relieves back stiffness and warms up the spine.

title: Hip Flexor Stretch
description: In a half-kneeling lunge, tuck the pelvis and shift forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the hip. Hold 30 seconds per side.

title: Child's Pose
description: Kneel, sit back on the heels and reach the arms forward with the forehead down. A relaxing stretch for back and shoulders after training.

title: Hamstring Stretch
description: Sit or stand and reach toward the toes with a straight back until you feel the back of the thigh stretch. Hold 30 seconds, no bouncing.

title: Kettlebell Swing
description: Hinge and snap the hips forward to swing the kettlebell to chest height. Builds power in glutes and hamstrings and doubles as cardio.
